findings.title: export_document loads by id across tenants, so any caller can export another tenant's document
findings.trigger: A caller in tenant t-river with docs:export requests /tenants/t-river/docs/<id of a t-stone document>/export. dispatch passes because the path tenant matches the caller; store.get(doc_id) returns the document whichever tenant owns it. Document ids are sequential, so they are easy to enumerate.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant disclosure of full document bodies. Use store.get_for_tenant(tenant_id, doc_id) like get_document and archive_document, and add a test for exporting another tenant's id under your own path.

findings.title: The new AGENTS.md rule is false and tells reviewers to skip tenant checks
findings.trigger: dispatch only compares the path tenant with the caller; it never checks that the document id belongs to that tenant.
findings.impact: The rule would wave through the cross-tenant read above and future ones. Remove it or restate that handlers must load through get_for_tenant.
